title: dsc check --dump-ast
description: What `dsc check --dump-ast` writes to standard output ([RCLI.1.12]): one document, the input's tree and the compile's diagnostics. The residue this schema cannot carry is [RCLI.1.12]'s.

tree.description: The document `dsc dump-ast` writes for the input ([RCLI.1.10]), or null when the input does not parse.

diagnostics.description: What `dsc compile` writes to standard error for the input: under `--diagnostics text`, a string, empty when it writes nothing; under `--diagnostics json`, the document of `dsc_diagnostics.schema.json`, or null when it writes none.
